function.name: observe
function.description: See the current game screen and the game state read from memory (location, party, map). Pending ordinary battle text advances to the next decision; all messages are listed.

function.name: press
function.description: Press Game Boy Advance buttons in order (up to 8), then see the resulting screen and game state. Field dialogue advances automatically: once a conversation opens, the harness presses B through every page until the next decision point and lists the pages; inputs left in your batch are not sent. Battle text advances the same way: while a battle runs its own messages, the harness presses B through each waiting message until a battle menu, a YES/NO question, another screen or the battle's end, and lists every battle message shown.

walking.description: Walk deliberately; do not add automatic running to directional travel.

function.name: navigate_to
function.description: The main way to move: use it for every walk of two or more tiles; give the destination and it finds the route around walls, ledges, water and people. Walk toward a coordinate on the current map using bounded A*. Supply its map_id. Uses only known local tiles, advancing toward a reachable local frontier for distant in-bounds targets; avoids unsupported terrain, hops a ledge only in its arrow direction, never crosses a walled side of a + tile, walks sand, cave and other floor the game allows, and stops on locks, unexpected movement or map changes. Does not press A, choose destinations, or activate a directional exit after arriving. Use walking=true for deliberate walking. Maximum 8 ordinary button attempts; inspect the returned state before continuing. To talk to a person or use an object, target the walkable tile next to it, face it and press A; the person's or object's own tile is not walkable. It cannot walk while a message is open: dismiss the message with B first. For a door, stairs or another listed warp, target the warp's own coordinates. After "command limit", call it again with the same destination to continue. If it ends in dialogue or a battle, the text advances automatically to the next decision point and its pages are listed.

function.name: get_dialogue
function.description: Search every dialogue page the harness advanced through this run, newest first, each whole with its speaker, map, position, turn and event number. Filters: speaker, contains (words), map (name or map id), last (default 10). It reads the record only; it does not press buttons.

speaker.description: Only pages whose speaker contains this text (case-insensitive), such as MOM or SCIENTIST_1.

map.description: Only pages shown on a map whose name or map id (for example 1/4) contains this text.

last.description: How many matching pages to return, newest first (default 10).
